plan: Given my low private value of $3, my strategy is to bid conservatively to avoid a loss. Rational bidders with higher values will likely bid closer to their values. I will bid slightly above my value to account for any low bids from others but not too high to risk a loss if I win. A bid of $3.5 balances potential winning with minimal risk of overpayment.

Given my value of $24, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize potential profit, considering the rational behavior of others. Assuming others bid near their values, I estimate their bids between $20 and $30. To win, my bid should be competitive but not exceed my value. I'll bid $22, expecting the third-highest bid to be lower, thus ensuring a net gain if I win.

Given my value of $11, I aim to bid below this to ensure profit if I win. Assuming rational opponents, they may bid close to their values. To maximize profit, I should bid conservatively, slightly below my value. A bid of $8.5 balances winning chances and profit, assuming others bid near their values. This strategy minimizes loss if I win and pay the third-highest bid.
